metadata.classification_rule: Fixes fatal server self-deadlock while maintaining full HTTP REST mutation contract.

divergences.binary_evidence: In main.sGuPXW2D (VA 0x740f40), cross-user rename acquires write lock usersLock.Lock() at 0x741630, updates in-memory users map, and calls saveUsers() (0x737500). Inside saveUsers(), instruction 0x73752a attempts to acquire read lock usersLock.RLock() on the non-reentrant sync.RWMutex. Because write lock is held by the same goroutine, this triggers a permanent self-deadlock. Reconstructed UsersStore.RenameUser() releases/manages locks without recursive acquisition before saving.
divergences.reason: Prevent signaling server permanent hang and denial-of-service on valid administrative cross-user rename requests while preserving exact REST API wire contract.
